description: Create a NEW picture, image, illustration, logo, poster, meme, icon, avatar or artwork from a text description (draw, generate, make, design an image), including a funny poster or meme about a current event or news story. Also restyle or edit a PHOTO the user just sent (turn it into a painting, museum canvas, Ghibli or cartoon style, change the background). Not for photos or snapshots from home cameras, not for describing or answering questions about a photo, not for charts of data, not for searching the web for existing pictures.
examples: Generate an image of a cozy cabin in the snow at sunset
Make me a logo for a bakery called Sweet Crumbs
Create a poster for Diwali dinner with warm lights
Can you paint a watercolor of the Golden Gate Bridge
Generate a wallpaper of a mountain lake, 16:9
Illustrate a dragon reading a book
Make a birthday card picture for Sam with balloons
Design an icon of a smiling sun, flat style
Generate a photorealistic image of a cup of masala chai
Make a funny meme about the latest news on Nvidia
Generate a satirical poster about the current situation in the stock market
Turn this photo into a Studio Ghibli style painting
Convert this picture into a museum style oil painting on canvas
Put a stadium background behind us in this photo
Make this photo look like a watercolor
Restyle my picture as a comic book panel
negatives: Show me pictures of the Eiffel Tower from the web
Plot my electricity usage as a chart
Capture a snapshot from the living room camera
Take a picture with the doorbell camera
Is this plant safe for my cat?
continuations: same but in a different style
try it with a night sky

profile.style: If the request is about a current event, news story or situation (for example a meme about something happening now), first use web.search (and web.fetch if needed) to learn what is actually going on, then make a light-hearted, non-hateful joke from the real facts; if you cannot find what they mean, ask one short question instead of guessing. If the message has a line '[Attached photo: <path>]' and the user wants that photo restyled or changed, call edit_image once with image set to exactly that path and prompt as an English instruction ('Turn this photo into a Studio Ghibli style painting, keep the people recognizable'; for a background change say what to put behind them and to keep the people unchanged); never invent a path. Otherwise call generate_image exactly once with an English prompt that expands the request into a concrete visual description (subject, style, setting, lighting). For a meme or poster put the caption in quotes inside the prompt: short, big, legible ALL-CAPS text, at most two short lines of at most five words each, spelled exactly (the picture model garbles long or many texts, so never put names or long sentences in quotes; show people and companies as characters or props instead). Use width and height only if the user asked for a shape (wide 720p 1280x720, tall poster 720x1280). If generation fails or is busy, say so plainly and do not retry more than once. After it succeeds, answer in one short sentence saying what you made and the joke or caption; the picture itself is attached to your reply automatically, so never mention a file path or claim you attached anything yourself.
